page.overview:
What is Fort Etnir?

Fort Etnir is an old ruined fortress north of Rogne and east of Kaer Trolde in northern Ard Skellig. It's currently home to an ice elemental and some gargoyles.

The once-proud fortress used to be a steadfast guardian of the northern expanses of Ard Skellig before falling to ruin and is presumably the final resting place of Chalimir's body after the witcher Gerd brought what was once the ruins' roof down on them.

The ruined fort also used to be the lair of a striga before Gerd slew it on orders of Torgeir the Red, the Jarl of An Skellig at the time.
